correctness.rationale: The explicit certificate has 64 distinct members of S_5^5. Exhaustive deterministic evaluation verifies that every one of the 3125 points of [5]^5 is mapped to five pairwise distinct values by at least one family member. This proves kappa(5)<=64. The published theorem mu(l)=kappa(l) then yields mu(5)<=64; no optimality inference is made from computation.
